name: dice
title: Dice
description: Real polyhedral dice. variant="tray" is a felt dice tray: grab a die, drag it and throw it; dice slide with friction, bounce off the walls and each other, and settle on whichever face ends up on top (a Throw button tosses them all). The default row variant hops, tumbles in 3D and settles with the rolled face up. Solids: d4 tetrahedron, d6 cube with pips, d8 octahedron, d10 pentagonal trapezohedron (0 to 9), d12 dodecahedron and d20 icosahedron, lit from the top left, with opposite faces adding up like real dice. d100 is a percentile pair (tens and ones). Mix kinds and colours per die (dice={[20, { sides: 6, color }]}), add a modifier to the total, hold dice between rolls, control values and held dice, roll from a button or by clicking a die, three sizes, two tones and a screen-reader announcement. Values are picked before the roll, so onRoll always matches what lands. Honours reduced motion.
